title: Oozy Italian Gorgonzola Bigoli
description: A sweet and tender Italian dish featuring gorgonzola dolce, served in a terracotta dish, this bigoli recipe is a festive and low-calorie-friendly option for any meal. It is a classic Piedmontese recipe with a unique katsuramuki cut.

ingredients.name: bigoli pasta
ingredients.notes: preferably made from durum wheat semolina

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bigoli pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat and add the chopped walnuts, cooking until lightly toasted.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the crumbled gorgonzola dolce and cook until melted and smooth.
Drain the cooked bigoli pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to coat with the gorgonzola sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the bigoli pasta to a terracotta dish and top with chopped fresh parsley.
Drizzle with the remaining 2 tablespoons of melted butter.
